description: Config for behavioral instructions by hook type. UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart use text file references (long-form). PostToolUse uses inline trigger-based messages (short, contextual, just-in-time). All instructions use teammate delegation via SendMessage, not Skill() invocations.

working-protocol.description: Mandatory cognitive procedures (meta-awareness, think-and-act, decide, verify-work)

model-orchestration.description: External model delegation requires cf-security validation

workflow-adherence.description: Ensure agent follows CLAUDE.md workflows and teammate delegation

memory-progress.description: Periodic instruction to record work progress via cf-knowledge-layer

memory-search-related.description: UserPromptSubmit: search via cf-knowledge-layer before new work

memory-work-start.description: UserPromptSubmit: delegate begin-work to cf-knowledge-layer when starting meaningful work (L1 enforced for branch creation)

memory-complete-work.description: UserPromptSubmit: delegate complete-work to cf-knowledge-layer before commits (L1 enforced cross-skill prerequisite)

session-start-procedure.description: Enforce CLAUDE.md Section 2 Session Start procedure

PostToolUse._description: Contextual just-in-time instructions triggered after specific tool operations. Uses inline messages with pattern matching. Different from UserPromptSubmit which fires at message start - these fire at the moment of action.

messages.Edit: MANDATORY: You edited a .md file. Delegate lint validation to cf-documentation teammate or apply cf-markdown-standards skill if loaded. FORBIDDEN: Proceeding without validation.
messages.Write: MANDATORY: New .md file created. VERIFY cf-markdown-standards were applied BEFORE creation. FORBIDDEN: Creating .md files without standards validation.

messages.Edit: MANDATORY: You edited a .sh file. Ensure cf-shell-standards compliance (shellcheck validation). FORBIDDEN: Committing without validation.
messages.Write: MANDATORY: New .sh file created. VERIFY cf-shell-standards were applied BEFORE creation. FORBIDDEN: Creating scripts without standards validation.

messages.Edit: MANDATORY: You edited a .py file. Ensure cf-python-standards compliance (flake8 validation). FORBIDDEN: Committing without validation.
messages.Write: MANDATORY: New .py file created. VERIFY cf-python-standards were applied BEFORE creation. FORBIDDEN: Creating scripts without standards validation.

messages.Edit: INVENTORY: If script purpose/dependencies changed, UPDATE docs/reference/project-scripts-inventory.md. Do NOT skip for significant changes.
messages.Write: INVENTORY REQUIRED: New script MUST be added to docs/reference/project-scripts-inventory.md. FORBIDDEN: Leaving new scripts undocumented.

messages.Edit: INVENTORY: If script purpose/dependencies changed, UPDATE docs/reference/project-scripts-inventory.md. Do NOT skip for significant changes.
messages.Write: INVENTORY REQUIRED: New script MUST be added to docs/reference/project-scripts-inventory.md. FORBIDDEN: Leaving new scripts undocumented.

script-inventory-update.note: Ensures project-scripts-inventory.md stays in sync with script changes

messages.Write: TESTING REQUIRED: New script created. Delegate test creation to cf-quality-assurance teammate or ensure test coverage directly. FORBIDDEN: Committing scripts without tests.
messages.Edit: TESTING REMINDER: Script edited. Consider delegating test updates to cf-quality-assurance if behavior changed.

messages.Write: TESTING REQUIRED: New Python script created. Delegate test creation to cf-quality-assurance teammate or ensure test coverage directly. FORBIDDEN: Committing scripts without tests.
messages.Edit: TESTING REMINDER: Python script edited. Consider delegating test updates to cf-quality-assurance if behavior changed.

script-test-coverage.note: Fires when creating or editing scripts - ensures test coverage consideration

code-exploration-lsp.message: TIP: For Python symbol searches, prefer LSP tools (get_definition, get_references) over Grep for semantic accuracy.

git-worktree-status.message: TIP: Delegate worktree management to cf-git-operations teammate for status tracking with metadata.

git-commit-memory.message: JUST-IN-TIME MEMORY SYNC: You are about to commit. Delegate to cf-knowledge-layer: SendMessage(recipient="cf-knowledge-layer", content="complete-work") NOW if not already done. FORBIDDEN: Committing without memory sync.
git-commit-memory.note: Fires at commit time - UserPromptSubmit reminder may have been minutes/hours ago

Stop._description: Block messages shown when Stop hook blocks agent completion. Dynamic parts (attempt X/Y, missing elements) handled by script, static instruction text from file.

verify-work-block.description: Instruction shown when verify-work is missing - directs to cf-working-protocol operation
